summary_1line: Ravana seeks combat with Bali, learns the might of Vishnu guarding him, fails to lift a divine disc, and departs after Vishnu chooses not to kill him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prahastha peers into a chamber where a radiant man sits laughing calmly inside a blazing fire.
Ravana confronts the terrifying guardian with red eyes and a flaming tongue, gripping a mace at the doorway.
Straining to lift the celestial disc, Ravana collapses to the ground bleeding while Bali watches from his seat.
